Select distinct molecule ChEMBL ID and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in Homo sapiens assays against target CHEMBL284. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records, activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Filter assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens' and target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL284'. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles.
